definition: One piece of an assembly — a fillet, a fascia, a cyma, a backband, a baseboard — with its own height and projection, in parts of the module, and its own profile: the shape a millworker actually needs.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's member fields, with members of the classical trim family as the examples. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, assemblies description: "Each assembly is a stack of members, bottom to top, dimensioned in PARTS of the module."; schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, members profile description: "The moulding profile. This is what makes an order drawable and what a millworker actually needs."; schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, members projection_parts description: "Projection in PARTS, measured from the datum this pack's projection_datum names"; docs/proportion.md: "fillet, listel, fascia, plinth, corona, abacus"; proportions/systems/trim-classical.json assemblies.wall_section_georgian.members[geo_base_cap_cyma].note: "The cyma reversa - concave above, convex below - is the correct cap for a base"; proportions/systems/trim-classical.json notes: "Georgian 6 in in seven members with a bold applied backband".
